blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) raised concerns about reports of election-related violence, voter intimidation, ballot irregularities, vote-buying and other incidents during the first regular parliamentary elections in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). In a statement issued Wednesday, the CHR said its Bantay Karapatan sa Halalan (BKH) 2026 deployed human rights monitors to assess whether the Sept. 14 elections upheld the rights to suffrage, security, equal access to public service and meaningful political representation, particularly among vulnerable and marginalized sectors.
